scenario.title: Recommendation should land cleanly
scenario.goal: Verify recommendation answers stay contextual and do not sprawl into bonus taxonomies.
expected_behavior: Stop cleanly unless more breadth is requested.
forbidden_behavior: Turning a recommendation into a system-by-system encyclopedia.

summary.final_text_preview:
**The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom**

It is the most complete, creative, and rewarding experience Nintendo has ever shipped. The freedom to solve problems your own way makes every moment feel like your own.
